title: Footwork Advanced - 6-Day
description: Expand your mobility with Push Shuffle and Rock Shuffle. Learn explosive entries and rhythmic weight shifting.

days.notes: Warm up with basic patterns. Ensure your foundation is solid before adding speed.
Introduction to Push Shuffle. Focus on the explosive push from the rear foot to close distance.
Introduction to Rock Shuffle. Develop a rhythmic weight shift to confuse opponents.
Rest day. Your calves may be working harder now with the explosive movements.
Transition between explosiveness and rhythm. Stay relaxed until the moment of the push.
Varying speed. Use Step and Slide for distance management and Push Shuffle for entry.

Author: Antoine Giniès
